subject: Planning: Inference topology deep-dive — staging integration checklist
messages:
From: Tom Becker <tom.becker@catalyst.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: request for inference topology deep-dive

Hi Ava / Marissa,

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier — we got a lot out of the conversation. Our engineering and infra leads would like a technical deep-dive next: the focus is verifying integration feasibility for our staging topology (VPC peering, private endpoints, and tokenized KV cache behavior). We expect ~6 people on our side (infra + security).

Goal: 90-minute session to validate network requirements, auth patterns, and model variant fallback behavior. Key constraints: 1) we need an on-prem equivalent architecture option, 2) encryption-in-transit + key management details, 3) sample throughput numbers for 512-token streaming.

Our availability (Pacific):
- Wed 2027-11-10: 09:00–12:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Thu 2027-11-11: 10:00–12:00

I've attached a short discovery notes PDF with the account context and a list of current infra owners. Can you propose an agenda and who from Redwood should join?

Thanks,
Tom Becker
Director of Engineering, Catalyst AI
[Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (3 pages, PDF)]
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Becker <tom.becker@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: request for inference topology deep-dive

Tom — thanks for the clear ask and the notes. Happy to run the session. Proposed attendees from our side: Ben Carter (Pre-sales Engineer) + me (Solutions), plus Marissa for post-session handoff. Suggested agenda (90 min):
1) 10 min intro + success criteria
2) 20 min architecture review (network, VPC patterns)
3) 25 min demo: staging topology + KV/prefix caching behavior
4) 20 min integration Q&A (auth, KMS, observability)
5) 15 min next steps / action items

We can cover quantization and performance expectations in the demo portion and bring concrete throughput numbers for 512-token streaming. Can you confirm whether your infra owners want a hands-on run with a small sample dataset or prefer a slide + demo walkthrough?

Suggested slots (Pacific):
- Wed 2027-11-10: 09:30–11:00 (we can make 90 min)
- Thu 2027-11-11: 10:00–11:30

If those look good, I'll send a calendar invite and include a short pre-read (proposed-agenda.docx). Also looping Ben so he can prep the demo environment checklist.

Best,
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172
[Attachment: proposed-agenda.docx]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Becker <tom.becker@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: request for inference topology deep-dive

Tom — putting a few logistics and asks on the table so we can maximize the 90 minutes:
- We prefer a 90-min hands-on demo where we show a staging topology deployed to a sandbox VPC and run a short throughput test (512 tokens, streaming) so you can see latency and KV cache hit behavior. If your infra team prefers slide-first, we can adapt.
- Can you share (before the session): a one-page network diagram, whether you allow temporary inbound from our test runners (we use a narrow egress flow or a signed tunnel), and the list of participant emails who should receive the calendar invite.
- Do you require an NDA or any restriction on recording? We usually record technical sessions for internal follow-up.

Proposed preparatory checklist (short):
1) Provide network diagram + constraining IP ranges
2) Confirm sandbox VPC access or allow signed tunnel (short-lived credentials)
3) Confirm whether KMS is customer-managed and KMS key alias if so
4) Confirm test dataset (we'll use a single 1000-line sample CSV if you don't provide)

If the Wed 11/10 09:30–11:00 slot works we can lock that — I've tentatively held time on my calendar.

Ben Carter
Principal Pre-sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Tom Becker <tom.becker@catalyst.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@catalyst.ai>, security@catalyst.ai
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: request for inference topology deep-dive

Hi Ava / Ben — 09:30–11:00 PT on Wed 2027-11-10 works for us. We'll plan for 6 participants: myself, our infra lead (Ethan Park), our platform security lead (Sara Liu), plus two engineers and one product manager. Sara (cc'd) will handle the security checklist; she requested the SOC2 excerpt you can share ahead of time. Recording is fine so long as it remains internal to both organizations.

Attaching the network diagram and our SOC2 excerpt. We'll also give you the participant email list by EOD Monday 11/8. For the tunnel: we prefer a short-lived signed tunnel approach; Ethan will include the specifics in the prep doc.

Thanks — looking forward.
Tom Becker
Director of Engineering, Catalyst AI
[Attachment: catalyst-network-diagram.png]
[Attachment: soc2-excerpt.pdf]
